1.name: bulbasaur
1.description:
A strange seed was
planted on its
back at birth. The plant sprouts
and grows with
this POKéMON.

2.name: ivysaur
2.description:
When the bulb on
its back grows
large, it appears to lose the
ability to stand
on its hind legs.

3.name: venusaur
3.description:
The plant blooms
when it is
absorbing solar energy. It stays
on the move to
seek sunlight.

4.name: charmander
4.description:
Obviously prefers
hot places. When
it rains, steam is said to spout
from the tip of
its tail.

5.name: charmeleon
5.description:
When it swings
its burning tail,
it elevates the temperature to
unbearably high
levels.

6.name: charizard
6.description:
Spits fire that
is hot enough to
melt boulders. Known to cause
forest fires
unintentionally.

7.name: squirtle
7.description:
After birth, its
back swells and
hardens into a shell. Powerfully
sprays foam from
its mouth.

8.name: wartortle
8.description:
Often hides in
water to stalk
unwary prey. For swimming fast, it
moves its ears to
maintain balance.

9.name: blastoise
9.description:
A brutal POKéMON
with pressurized
water jets on its shell. They are
used for high
speed tackles.

10.name: caterpie
10.description:
如果碰到牠頭上的觸角，
牠就會分泌強烈的臭味
來保護自己。

11.name: metapod
11.description:
This POKéMON is
vulnerable to
attack while its shell is soft,
exposing its weak
and tender body.

12.name: butterfree
12.description:
In battle, it
flaps its wings
at high speed to release highly
toxic dust into
the air.

13.name: weedle
13.description:
Often found in
forests, eating
leaves. It has a sharp
venomous stinger
on its head.

14.name: kakuna
14.description:
Almost incapable
of moving, this
POKéMON can only harden its shell
to protect itself
from predators.

15.name: beedrill
15.description:
It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and
its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

16.name: pidgey
16.description:
A common sight in
forests and woods.
It flaps its wings at ground
level to kick up
blinding sand.

17.name: pidgeotto
17.description:
Very protective
of its sprawling
territorial area, this POKéMON will
fiercely peck at
any intruder.

18.name: pidgeot
18.description:
When hunting, it
skims the surface
of water at high speed to pick off
unwary prey such
as MAGIKARP.

19.name: rattata
19.description:
キバが２つ。とにかく　なんでも
かじってみる。１ぴき　みつけたら
４０ぴきは　そこに　すんでるはず。

20.name: raticate
20.description:
Ses pattes arrière lui permettent de traverser les
rivières. Il est toujours en quête de nourriture.

21.name: spearow
21.description:
It flaps its small wings busily to
fly. Using its beak, it searches
in grass for prey.

22.name: fearow
22.description:
With its huge and
magnificent wings,
it can keep aloft without ever
having to land
for rest.

23.name: ekans
23.description:
Moves silently
and stealthily.
Eats the eggs of birds, such as
PIDGEY and
SPEAROW, whole.

24.name: arbok
24.description:
It is rumored that
the ferocious
warning markings on its belly
differ from area
to area.

25.name: pikachu
25.description:
When several of
these POKéMON
gather, their electricity could
build and cause
lightning storms.

26.name: raichu
26.description:
Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself
from its own high-voltage power.

27.name: sandshrew
27.description:
Burrows deep
underground in
arid locations far from water.
It only emerges
to hunt for food.

28.name: sandslash
28.description:
Curls up into a
spiny ball when
threatened. It can roll while
curled up to
attack or escape.

29.name: nidoran-f
29.description:
Although small,
its venomous
barbs render this POKéMON dangerous.
The female has
smaller horns.

30.name: nidorina
30.description:
The female's horn
develops slowly.
Prefers physical attacks such as
clawing and
biting.

31.name: nidoqueen
31.description:
Its hard scales
provide strong
protection. It uses its hefty
bulk to execute
powerful moves.

32.name: nidoran-m
32.description:
Stiffens its ears
to sense danger.
The larger its horns, the more
powerful its
secreted venom.

33.name: nidorino
33.description:
神經質且容易發脾氣打架。
當體內的腎上腺素增加時，
毒素的濃度也會提升。

34.name: nidoking
34.description:
It uses its
powerful tail in
battle to smash, constrict, then
break the prey's
bones.

35.name: clefairy
35.description:
Its magical and
cute appeal has
many admirers. It is rare and
found only in
certain areas.

36.name: clefable
36.description:
A timid fairy
POKéMON that is
rarely seen. It will run and hide
the moment it
senses people.

37.name: vulpix
37.description:
At the time of
birth, it has
just one tail. The tail splits
from its tip as
it grows older.

38.name: ninetales
38.description:
Very smart and
very vengeful.
Grabbing one of its many tails
could result in a
1000-year curse.

39.name: jigglypuff
39.description:
When its huge eyes
light up, it sings
a mysteriously soothing melody
that lulls its
enemies to sleep.

40.name: wigglytuff
40.description:
The body is soft
and rubbery. When
angered, it will suck in air and
inflate itself to
an enormous size.

41.name: zubat
41.description:
因為沒有眼珠所以看不見東西。
會從口中發出超音波
來探測周圍的狀況。

42.name: golbat
42.description:
Once it strikes,
it will not stop
draining energy from the victim
even if it gets
too heavy to fly.

43.name: oddish
43.description:
During the day,
it keeps its face
buried in the ground. At night,
it wanders around
sowing its seeds.

44.name: gloom
44.description:
The fluid that
oozes from its
mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar
that is used to
attract prey.

45.name: vileplume
45.description:
It has the world’s largest petals. With every step,
the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

46.name: paras
46.description:
Burrows to suck
tree roots. The
mushrooms on its back grow by draw­
ing nutrients from
the bug host.

47.name: parasect
47.description:
A host-parasite
pair in which the
parasite mushroom has taken over the
host bug. Prefers
damp places.

48.name: venonat
48.description:
Lives in the
shadows of tall
trees where it eats insects. It
is attracted by
light at night.

49.name: venomoth
49.description:
The dustlike scales covering its wings
are color-coded to indicate the kinds of
poison it has.

50.name: diglett
50.description:
피부가 매우 얇아서
빛을 쪼이게 되면 혈액이
데워져 약해진다.

51.name: dugtrio
51.description:
A team of DIGLETT
triplets.
It triggers huge earthquakes by
burrowing 60 miles
underground.

52.name: meowth
52.description:
It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on
its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with
Galarian Meowth.

53.name: persian
53.description:
Although its fur
has many admirers,
it is tough to raise as a pet
because of its
fickle meanness.

54.name: psyduck
54.description:
While lulling its
enemies with its
vacant look, this wily POKéMON will
use psychokinetic
powers.

55.name: golduck
55.description:
Often seen swim­
ming elegantly by
lake shores. It is often mistaken
for the Japanese
monster, Kappa.

56.name: mankey
56.description:
Extremely quick to
anger. It could
be docile one moment then
thrashing away
the next instant.

57.name: primeape
57.description:
Always furious
and tenacious to
boot. It will not abandon chasing
its quarry until
it is caught.

58.name: growlithe
58.description:
Very protective
of its territory.
It will bark and bite to repel
intruders from
its space.

59.name: arcanine
59.description:
A POKéMON that
has been admired
since the past for its beauty.
It runs agilely
as if on wings.

60.name: poliwag
60.description:
Its newly grown
legs prevent it
from running. It appears to prefer
swimming than
trying to stand.

61.name: poliwhirl
61.description:
Capable of living
in or out of
water. When out of water, it
sweats to keep
its body slimy.

62.name: poliwrath
62.description:
An adept swimmer
at both the front
crawl and breast stroke. Easily
overtakes the best
human swimmers.

63.name: abra
63.description:
Using its ability
to read minds, it
will identify impending danger
and TELEPORT to
safety.

64.name: kadabra
64.description:
It emits special
alpha waves from
its body that induce headaches
just by being
close by.

65.name: alakazam
65.description:
Its brain can out­
perform a super­
computer. Its intelligence
quotient is said
to be 5,000.

66.name: machop
66.description:
Malgré sa petite taille, sa force
lui permet de soulever plusieurs
Racaillou à la fois.

67.name: machoke
67.description:
Its muscular body
is so powerful, it
must wear a power save belt to be
able to regulate
its motions.

68.name: machamp
68.description:
Using its heavy
muscles, it throws
powerful punches that can send the
victim clear over
the horizon.

69.name: bellsprout
69.description:
A carnivorous
POKéMON that traps
and eats bugs. It uses its root
feet to soak up
needed moisture.

70.name: weepinbell
70.description:
It spits out
POISONPOWDER to
immobilize the enemy and then
finishes it with
a spray of ACID.

71.name: victreebel
71.description:
Dieses Pokémon soll in großen Kolonien
tief im Dschungel leben, doch niemand
kann dies bestätigen.

72.name: tentacool
72.description:
Drifts in shallow
seas. Anglers who
hook them by accident are
often punished by
its stinging acid.

73.name: tentacruel
73.description:
The tentacles are
normally kept
short. On hunts, they are extended
to ensnare and
immobilize prey.

74.name: geodude
74.description:
Found in fields
and mountains.
Mistaking them for boulders,
people often step
or trip on them.

75.name: graveler
75.description:
De naturaleza descuidada y libre, no le importa
dañarse cuando baja rodando montañas.

76.name: golem
76.description:
Its boulder-like
body is extremely
hard. It can easily withstand
dynamite blasts
without damage.

77.name: ponyta
77.description:
Its hooves are 10
times harder than
diamonds. It can trample anything
completely flat
in little time.

78.name: rapidash
78.description:
Galopa a casi 240 km por hora. Su crin ardiente
parece una flecha cuando corre.

79.name: slowpoke
79.description:
Descansa ocioso junto al agua. Si algo muerde su
cola, no lo notará en todo el día.

80.name: slowbro
80.description:
The SHELLDER that
is latched onto
SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed
on the host's left
over scraps.

81.name: magnemite
81.description:
Uses anti-gravity
to stay suspended.
Appears without warning and uses
THUNDER WAVE and
similar moves.

82.name: magneton
82.description:
Formed by several
MAGNEMITEs linked
together. They frequently appear
when sunspots
flare up.

83.name: farfetchd
83.description:
The sprig of
green onions it
holds is its weapon. It is
used much like a
metal sword.

84.name: doduo
84.description:
A bird that makes
up for its poor
flying with its fast foot speed.
Leaves giant
footprints.

85.name: dodrio
85.description:
由嘟嘟的某个头分裂
出的变种。以60千米的
时速在草原上奔跑。

86.name: seel
86.description:
The protruding
horn on its head
is very hard. It is used for
bashing through
thick ice.

87.name: dewgong
87.description:
Stores thermal
energy in its
body. Swims at a steady 8 knots
even in intensely
cold waters.

88.name: grimer
88.description:
Appears in filthy
areas. Thrives by
sucking up polluted sludge
that is pumped
out of factories.

89.name: muk
89.description:
Thickly covered
with a filthy,
vile sludge. It is so toxic, even
its footprints
contain poison.

90.name: shellder
90.description:
Its hard shell
repels any kind
of attack. It is vulnerable
only when its
shell is open.

91.name: cloyster
91.description:
When attacked, it
launches its
horns in quick volleys. Its
innards have
never been seen.

92.name: gastly
92.description:
Almost invisible,
this gaseous
POKéMON cloaks the target and
puts it to sleep
without notice.

93.name: haunter
93.description:
Because of its
ability to slip
through block walls, it is said
to be from an­
other dimension.

94.name: gengar
94.description:
Under a full moon,
this POKéMON
likes to mimic the shadows of
people and laugh
at their fright.

95.name: onix
95.description:
As it grows, the
stone portions of
its body harden to become similar
to a diamond, but
colored black.

96.name: drowzee
96.description:
Puts enemies to
sleep then eats
their dreams. Occasionally gets
sick from eating
bad dreams.

97.name: hypno
97.description:
When it locks eyes
with an enemy, it
will use a mix of PSI moves such as
HYPNOSIS and
CONFUSION.

98.name: krabby
98.description:
Its pincers are
not only powerful
weapons, they are used for balance
when walking
sideways.

99.name: kingler
99.description:
The large pincer
has 10000 hp of
crushing power. However, its huge
size makes it
unwieldy to use.

100.name: voltorb
100.description:
Usually found in
power plants.
Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL,
they have zapped
many people.

101.name: electrode
101.description:
It stores electric
energy under very
high pressure. It often explodes
with little or no
provocation.

102.name: exeggcute
102.description:
Often mistaken
for eggs.
When disturbed, they quickly
gather and attack
in swarms.

103.name: exeggutor
103.description:
Legend has it that
on rare occasions,
one of its heads will drop off and
continue on as an
EXEGGCUTE.

104.name: cubone
104.description:
Because it never
removes its skull
helmet, no one has ever seen
this POKéMON's
real face.

105.name: marowak
105.description:
将骨头像回力镖一样扔出去，
击落天敌秃鹰娜来复仇。

106.name: hitmonlee
106.description:
When in a hurry,
its legs lengthen
progressively. It runs smoothly
with extra long,
loping strides.

107.name: hitmonchan
107.description:
While apparently
doing nothing, it
fires punches in lightning fast
volleys that are
impossible to see.

108.name: lickitung
108.description:
Its tongue can be
extended like a
chameleon's. It leaves a tingling
sensation when it
licks enemies.

109.name: koffing
109.description:
Because it stores
several kinds of
toxic gases in its body, it is
prone to exploding
without warning.

110.name: weezing
110.description:
Where two kinds
of poison gases
meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a
WEEZING over many
years.

111.name: rhyhorn
111.description:
A POKéMON with a
one-track mind.
Once it charges,  it won't stop
running until it
falls asleep.

112.name: rhydon
112.description:
Protected by an
armor-like hide,
it is capable of living in molten
lava of 3,600
degrees.

113.name: chansey
113.description:
A rare and elusive
POKéMON that is
said to bring happiness to those
who manage to get
it.

114.name: tangela
114.description:
The whole body is
swathed with wide
vines that are similar to sea­
weed. Its vines
shake as it walks.

115.name: kangaskhan
115.description:
The infant rarely
ventures out of
its mother's protective pouch
until it is 3
years old.

116.name: horsea
116.description:
Known to shoot
down flying bugs
with precision blasts of ink
from the surface
of the water.

117.name: seadra
117.description:
Capable of swim­
ming backwards by
rapidly flapping its wing-like
pectoral fins and
stout tail.

118.name: goldeen
118.description:
Its tail fin
billows like an
elegant ballroom dress, giving it
the nickname of
the Water Queen.

119.name: seaking
119.description:
In the autumn spawning season, they can
be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and
creeks.

120.name: staryu
120.description:
If its body is torn, it can grow
back if the red core remains.
The core flashes at midnight.

121.name: starmie
121.description:
Its central core
glows with the
seven colors of the rainbow. Some
people value the
core as a gem.

122.name: mr-mime
122.description:
If interrupted
while it is
miming, it will slap around the
offender with its
broad hands.

123.name: scyther
123.description:
With ninja-like
agility and speed,
it can create the illusion that
there is more
than one.

124.name: jynx
124.description:
It seductively
wiggles its hips
as it walks. It can cause people
to dance in
unison with it.

125.name: electabuzz
125.description:
Normally found
near power plants,
they can wander away and cause
major blackouts
in cities.

126.name: magmar
126.description:
Its body always
burns with an
orange glow that enables it to
hide perfectly
among flames.

127.name: pinsir
127.description:
If it fails to
crush the victim
in its pincers, it will swing it
around and toss
it hard.

128.name: tauros
128.description:
When it targets
an enemy, it
charges furiously while whipping its
body with its
long tails.

129.name: magikarp
129.description:
In the distant
past, it was
somewhat stronger than the horribly
weak descendants
that exist today.

130.name: gyarados
130.description:
Once it begins to rampage, a
GYARADOS will burn everything
down, even in a harsh storm.

131.name: lapras
131.description:
A POKéMON that
has been over­
hunted almost to extinction. It
can ferry people
across the water.

132.name: ditto
132.description:
Capable of copying
an enemy's genetic
code to instantly transform itself
into a duplicate
of the enemy.

133.name: eevee
133.description:
Its genetic code
is irregular.
It may mutate if it is exposed to
radiation from
element STONEs.

134.name: vaporeon
134.description:
Lives close to
water. Its long
tail is ridged with a fin which
is often mistaken
for a mermaid's.

135.name: jolteon
135.description:
It accumulates
negative ions in
the atmosphere to blast out 10000-
volt lightning
bolts.

136.name: flareon
136.description:
When storing
thermal energy in
its body, its temperature could
soar to over 1600
degrees.

137.name: porygon
137.description:
A POKéMON that
consists entirely
of programming code. Capable of
moving freely in
cyberspace.

138.name: omanyte
138.description:
Although long
extinct, in rare
cases, it can be genetically
resurrected from
fossils.

139.name: omastar
139.description:
A prehistoric
POKéMON that died
out when its heavy shell made
it impossible to
catch prey.

140.name: kabuto
140.description:
A POKéMON that
was resurrected
from a fossil found in what was
once the ocean
floor eons ago.

141.name: kabutops
141.description:
È un perfetto nuotatore. Taglia la preda
con le sue falci e ne succhia il sangue.

142.name: aerodactyl
142.description:
A Pokémon that roamed the skies
in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are
like saw blades.

143.name: snorlax
143.description:
Very lazy. Just
eats and sleeps.
As its rotund bulk builds, it
becomes steadily
more slothful.

144.name: articuno
144.description:
A legendary bird
POKéMON that is
said to appear to doomed people who
are lost in icy
mountains.

145.name: zapdos
145.description:
かみなりぐもの　なかに　いると
いわれる　でんせつの　ポケモン。
カミナリを　じざいに　あやつる。

146.name: moltres
146.description:
Known as the
legendary bird of
fire. Every flap of its wings
creates a dazzling
flash of flames.

147.name: dratini
147.description:
Long considered a
mythical POKéMON
until recently when a small
colony was found
living underwater.

148.name: dragonair
148.description:
人们相信它能操纵天气，
所以在哈克龙栖息的湖里，
供品总是源源不断。

149.name: dragonite
149.description:
An extremely
rarely seen
marine POKéMON. Its intelligence
is said to match
that of humans.

150.name: mewtwo
150.description:
It was created by
a scientist after
years of horrific gene splicing and
DNA engineering
experiments.

151.name: mew
151.description:
So rare that it
is still said to
be a mirage by many experts. Only
a few people have
seen it worldwide.

152.name: chikorita
152.description:
A sweet aroma
gently wafts from
the leaf on its head. It is docile
and loves to soak
up the sun's rays.

153.name: bayleef
153.description:
The scent of
spices comes from
around its neck. Somehow, sniffing
it makes you want
to fight.

154.name: meganium
154.description:
The aroma that
rises from its
petals contains a substance that
calms aggressive
feelings.

155.name: cyndaquil
155.description:
It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on
its back burn more vigorously.

156.name: quilava
156.description:
Be careful if it
turns its back
during battle. It means that it will
attack with the
fire on its back.

157.name: typhlosion
157.description:
If its rage peaks,
it becomes so hot
that anything that touches it will
instantly go
up in flames.

158.name: totodile
158.description:
Its well-developed
jaws are powerful
and capable of crushing anything.
Even its trainer
must be careful.

159.name: croconaw
159.description:
If it loses a
fang, a new one
grows back in its place. There are
always 48 fangs
lining its mouth.

160.name: feraligatr
160.description:
When it bites with
its massive and
powerful jaws, it shakes its head
and savagely tears
its victim up.

161.name: sentret
161.description:
A very cautious
POKéMON, it raises
itself up using its tail to get a
better view of its
surroundings.

162.name: furret
162.description:
It makes a nest to
suit its long and
skinny body. The nest is impossible
for other POKéMON
to enter.

163.name: hoothoot
163.description:
It always stands
on one foot. It
changes feet so fast, the movement
can rarely be
seen.

164.name: noctowl
164.description:
Its eyes are
specially adapted.
They concentrate even faint light
and enable it to
see in the dark.

165.name: ledyba
165.description:
It is very timid.
It will be afraid
to move if it is alone. But it will
be active if it is
in a group.

166.name: ledian
166.description:
When the stars
flicker in the
night sky, it flutters about,
scattering a
glowing powder.

167.name: spinarak
167.description:
It lies still in
the same pose for
days in its web, waiting for its
unsuspecting prey
to wander close.

168.name: ariados
168.description:
也有地区会使用
阿利多斯的丝来织布。
因布料结实而广受好评。

169.name: crobat
169.description:
It flies so si­
lently through the
dark on its four wings that it may
not be noticed
even when nearby.

170.name: chinchou
170.description:
Chinchou blink their shining antennae at one
another to claim their respective turf.

171.name: lanturn
171.description:
The light it emits
is so bright that
it can illuminate the sea's surface
from a depth of
over three miles.

172.name: pichu
172.description:
It is not yet
skilled at storing
electricity. It may send out a
jolt if amused
or startled.

173.name: cleffa
173.description:
Because of its
unusual, star-like
silhouette, people believe that it
came here on
a meteor.

174.name: igglybuff
174.description:
It has a very soft
body. If it starts
to roll, it will bounce all over
and be impossible
to stop.

175.name: togepi
175.description:
The shell seems to
be filled with
joy. It is said that it will share
good luck when
treated kindly.

176.name: togetic
176.description:
They say that it
will appear before
kindhearted, car­ ing people and
shower them with
happiness.

177.name: natu
177.description:
Because its wings
aren't yet fully
grown, it has to hop to get around.
It is always star­
ing at something.

178.name: xatu
178.description:
They say that it
stays still and
quiet because it is seeing both the
past and future at
the same time.

179.name: mareep
179.description:
If static elec­
tricity builds in
its body, its fleece doubles in
volume. Touching
it will shock you.

180.name: flaaffy
180.description:
푹신푹신한 털은 전기를
모으기 쉽지만 고무 같은 피부
덕분에 자신은 마비되지 않는다.

181.name: ampharos
181.description:
The tail's tip
shines brightly
and can be seen from far away. It
acts as a beacon
for lost people.

182.name: bellossom
182.description:
Plentiful in the tropics. When it
dances, its petals rub together and
make a pleasant ringing sound.

183.name: marill
183.description:
The tip of its
tail, which con­
tains oil that is lighter than wa­
ter, lets it swim
without drowning.

184.name: azumarill
184.description:
It lives in water virtually all day long.
Its body color and pattern act as
camouflage that makes it tough for
enemies to spot in water.

185.name: sudowoodo
185.description:
Although it always
pretends to be a
tree, its composi­ tion appears to be
closer to a rock
than a plant.

186.name: politoed
186.description:
If POLIWAG and
POLIWHIRL hear its
echoing cry, they respond by gather­
ing from far and
wide.

187.name: hoppip
187.description:
To keep from being
blown away by the
wind, they gather in clusters. They
do enjoy gentle
breezes, though.

188.name: skiploom
188.description:
The bloom on top
of its head opens
and closes as the temperature fluc­
tuates up and
down.

189.name: jumpluff
189.description:
Once it catches
the wind, it deft­
ly controls its cotton-puff spores
to float, even
around the world.

190.name: aipom
190.description:
Sa queue est aussi agile que ses
mains. Il vit en haut des grands
arbres.

191.name: sunkern
191.description:
It may drop out of
the sky suddenly.
If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will
violently shake
its leaves.

192.name: sunflora
192.description:
It converts sun­
light into energy.
In the darkness after sunset, it
closes its petals
and becomes still.

193.name: yanma
193.description:
If it flaps its
wings really fast,
it can generate shock waves that
will shatter win­
dows in the area.

194.name: wooper
194.description:
This POKéMON lives
in cold water. It
will leave the water to search
for food when it
gets cold outside.

195.name: quagsire
195.description:
This carefree
POKéMON has an
easy-going nature. While swimming, it
always bumps into
boat hulls.

196.name: espeon
196.description:
It uses the fine
hair that covers
its body to sense air currents and
predict its ene­
my's actions.

197.name: umbreon
197.description:
When agitated,
this POKéMON pro­
tects itself by spraying poisonous
sweat from its
pores.

198.name: murkrow
198.description:
Feared and loathed
by many, it is
believed to bring misfortune to all
those who see it
at night.

199.name: slowking
199.description:
It has incredible
intellect and in­
tuition. Whatever the situation, it
remains calm and
collected.

200.name: misdreavus
200.description:
It likes playing
mischievous tricks
such as screaming and wailing to
startle people at
night.

201.name: unown
201.description:
Their shapes look
like hieroglyphs
on ancient tab­ lets. It is said
that the two are
somehow related.

202.name: wobbuffet
202.description:
Odia la luz y las sacudidas. Si le atacan, infla su
cuerpo para aumentar su contraataque.

203.name: girafarig
203.description:
Its tail has a
small brain of its
own. Beware! If you get close, it
may react to your
scent and bite.

204.name: pineco
204.description:
It likes to make
its shell thicker
by adding layers of tree bark. The
additional weight
doesn't bother it.

205.name: forretress
205.description:
Its entire body is
shielded by a
steel-hard shell. What lurks inside
the armor is a
total mystery.

206.name: dunsparce
206.description:
When spotted, this
POKéMON escapes
backward by furi­ ously boring into
the ground with
its tail.

207.name: gligar
207.description:
It flies straight
at its target's
face then clamps down on the star­
tled victim to
inject poison.

208.name: steelix
208.description:
It is thought its body transformed
as a result of iron accumulating
internally from swallowing soil.

209.name: snubbull
209.description:
Although it looks
frightening, it is
actually kind and affectionate. It
is very popular
among women.

210.name: granbull
210.description:
It is actually
timid and easily
spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails
about to fend off
its attacker.

211.name: qwilfish
211.description:
To fire its poison
spikes, it must
inflate its body by drinking over
2.6 gallons of
water all at once.

212.name: scizor
212.description:
It has a steel-hard body. It
intimidates foes by upraising its
eye-patterned pincers.

213.name: shuckle
213.description:
The BERRIES it
stores in its
vase-like shell decompose and
become a gooey
liquid.

214.name: heracross
214.description:
It is usually docile, but if it is
disturbed while sipping honey,
it chases off the intruder with its horn.

215.name: sneasel
215.description:
性格狡猾且兇猛。
會趁著雙親不在時
侵入巢穴把蛋盜走。

216.name: teddiursa
216.description:
If it finds honey,
its crescent mark
glows. It always licks its paws
because they are
soaked with honey.

217.name: ursaring
217.description:
Although it is a
good climber, it
prefers to snap trees with its
forelegs and eat
fallen BERRIES.

218.name: slugma
218.description:
Asiduo a las zonas volcánicas, se desliza lentamente
en busca de lugares calientes.

219.name: magcargo
219.description:
The shell on its
back is just skin
that has cooled and hardened. It
breaks easily with
a slight touch.

220.name: swinub
220.description:
It rubs its snout
on the ground to
find and dig up food. It sometimes
discovers hot
springs.

221.name: piloswine
221.description:
Because the long
hair all over its
body obscures its sight, it just
keeps charging
repeatedly.

222.name: corsola
222.description:
It continuously
sheds and grows.
The tip of its head is prized as
a treasure for its
beauty.

223.name: remoraid
223.description:
It has superb ac­
curacy. The water
it shoots out can strike even moving
prey from more
than 300 feet.

224.name: octillery
224.description:
It traps enemies
with its suction-
cupped tentacles then smashes them
with its rock-hard
head.

225.name: delibird
225.description:
It carries food
all day long.
There are tales about lost people
who were saved by
the food it had.

226.name: mantine
226.description:
As it majestically
swims, it doesn't
care if REMORAID attach to it for
scavenging its
leftovers.

227.name: skarmory
227.description:
Its sturdy wings
look heavy, but
they are actually hollow and light,
allowing it to fly
freely in the sky.

228.name: houndour
228.description:
It uses different
kinds of cries for
communicating with others of its kind
and for pursuing
its prey.

229.name: houndoom
229.description:
If you are burned
by the flames it
shoots from its mouth, the pain
will never go
away.

230.name: kingdra
230.description:
It is said that it
usually hides in
underwater caves. It can create
whirlpools by
yawning.

231.name: phanpy
231.description:
It swings its long
snout around play­
fully, but because it is so strong,
that can be dan­
gerous.

232.name: donphan
232.description:
It has sharp, hard
tusks and a rugged
hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough
to knock down a
house.

233.name: porygon2
233.description:
This upgraded
version of PORYGON
is designed for space exploration.
It can't fly,
though.

234.name: stantler
234.description:
The curved antlers
subtly change the
flow of air to create a strange
space where real­
ity is distorted.

235.name: smeargle
235.description:
A special fluid
oozes from the tip
of its tail. It paints the fluid
everywhere to mark
its territory.

236.name: tyrogue
236.description:
It is always
bursting with en­
ergy. To make it­ self stronger, it
keeps on fighting
even if it loses.

237.name: hitmontop
237.description:
If you become
enchanted by its
smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks,
you may get
drilled hard.

238.name: smoochum
238.description:
Its lips are the
most sensitive
parts on its body. It always uses its
lips first to
examine things.

239.name: elekid
239.description:
常常跟來搶奪電力的
托戈德瑪爾打架。
結果通常是不分上下。

240.name: magby
240.description:
Each and every
time it inhales
and exhales, hot embers dribble out
of its mouth and
nostrils.

241.name: miltank
241.description:
Si tiene crías, la leche que produce contiene muchos
más nutrientes de lo normal.

242.name: blissey
242.description:
Anyone who takes
even one bite of
BLISSEY's egg be­ comes unfailingly
caring and pleas­
ant to everyone.

243.name: raikou
243.description:
The rain clouds it
carries let it
fire thunderbolts at will. They say
that it descended
with lightning.

244.name: entei
244.description:
Volcanoes erupt
when it barks. Un­
able to restrain its extreme power,
it races headlong
around the land.

245.name: suicune
245.description:
It races around the world to
purify fouled water. It dashes
away with the north wind.

246.name: larvitar
246.description:
It feeds on soil.
After it has eaten
a large mountain, it will fall
asleep so it can
grow.

247.name: pupitar
247.description:
Its shell is as
hard as sheet
rock, and it is also very strong.
Its THRASHING can
topple a mountain.

248.name: tyranitar
248.description:
Its body can't be
harmed by any sort
of attack, so it is very eager to
make challenges
against enemies.

249.name: lugia
249.description:
It is said that it
quietly spends its
time deep at the bottom of the sea
because its powers
are too strong.

250.name: ho-oh
250.description:
Legends claim this
POKéMON flies the
world's skies con­ tinuously on its
magnificent seven-
colored wings.

251.name: celebi
251.description:
This POKéMON wan­
ders across time.
Grass and trees flourish in the
forests in which
it has appeared.

252.name: treecko
252.description:
TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom
of its feet that enable it to scale
vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes
with its thick tail.

253.name: grovyle
253.description:
발달한 넓적다리의 근육이
경이로운 순발력과
도약력을 만들어 낸다.

254.name: sceptile
254.description:
The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body
are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is
very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe
from above or behind.

255.name: torchic
255.description:
TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER,
following behind with unsteady
steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over
1,800 degrees F, including fireballs
that leave the foe scorched black.

256.name: combusken
256.description:
COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and
thighs by running through fields and
mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed
and power, enabling it to dole out ten
kicks in one second.

257.name: blaziken
257.description:
In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense
flames from its wrists and attacks foes
courageously. The stronger the foe, the more
intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.

258.name: mudkip
258.description:
The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly
sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense
movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking
place around it without using its eyes.

259.name: marshtomp
259.description:
The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is
enveloped by a thin, sticky film that
enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches
when the ocean tide is low.

260.name: swampert
260.description:
SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough
power to easily drag a boulder weighing
more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision
that lets it see even in murky water.

261.name: poochyena
261.description:
At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite
at anything that moves.
This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted.
However, it may turn tail if the prey
strikes back.

262.name: mightyena
262.description:
Les Grahyèna forment des meutes de dix qui
excellent au travail de groupe pour capturer leurs
proies.

263.name: zigzagoon
263.description:
ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders
everywhere at all times. This POKéMON
does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything
that it happens to see.

264.name: linoone
264.description:
LINOONE always runs full speed and only
in straight lines. If facing an obstacle,
it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by
gently curving roads.

265.name: wurmple
265.description:
Le encanta comer hojas. Si le ataca un Starly, se
defenderá con sus púas.

266.name: silcoon
266.description:
SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch
using silk to keep from falling. There, 
this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution.
It peers out of the silk cocoon through
a small hole.

267.name: beautifly
267.description:
BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet
pollen of flowers. If you want to see
this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY
is sure to come looking for pollen.

268.name: cascoon
268.description:
CASCOON makes its protective cocoon
by wrapping its body entirely with a
fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens.
This POKéMON prepares for its evolution
inside the cocoon.

269.name: dustox
269.description:
DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light.
Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted
by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the
leaves off roadside trees for food.

270.name: lotad
270.description:
It searches about for clean water. If it does not
drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

271.name: lombre
271.description:
It lives at the water’s edge where it is
sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass
by day and becomes active at night.

272.name: ludicolo
272.description:
LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as
it hears cheerful, festive music.
This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking
outings.

273.name: seedot
273.description:
SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree
branch using the top of its head.
It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch.
The more water it drinks, the glossier
this POKéMON’s body becomes.

274.name: nuzleaf
274.description:
NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown
forests. They occasionally venture out
of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long
nose pinched.

275.name: shiftry
275.description:
It lives quietly in the deep forest.
It is said to create chilly winter
winds with the fans it holds.

276.name: taillow
276.description:
TAILLOW courageously stands its
ground against foes, however strong
they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant
even after a loss. On the other hand,
it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

277.name: swellow
277.description:
SWELLOW flies high above our heads,
making graceful arcs in the sky.
This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless
prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s
clawed feet, preventing escape.

278.name: wingull
278.description:
WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey
and valuables in its beak and hiding
them in all sorts of locations. This POKéMON rides the winds and flies
as if it were skating across the sky.

279.name: pelipper
279.description:
It is a messenger of the skies,
carrying small Pokémon and
eggs to safety in its bill.

280.name: ralts
280.description:
RALTS senses the emotions of
people using the horns on its head.
This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws
closer if it senses that the person has
a positive disposition.

281.name: kirlia
281.description:
It is said that a KIRLIA that is
exposed to the positive emotions of
its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic
powers with its highly developed brain.

282.name: gardevoir
282.description:
GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the
future. If it senses impending danger
to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at
full power.

283.name: surskit
283.description:
すいめんを　すべるように　あるく。
あたまの　さきから　あまい　においを
だして　えものを　さそう。

284.name: masquerain
284.description:
MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with
the eyelike patterns on its antennas.
This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even
sideways and backwards - as if it were
a helicopter.

285.name: shroomish
285.description:
SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark
depths of forests. They are often
found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that
is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

286.name: breloom
286.description:
Erst lässt es den Gegner seine giftigen Sporen
einatmen, dann traktiert es ihn mit Boxschlägen.

287.name: slakoth
287.description:
SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty
hours every day. Because it moves so
little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists
of just three leaves.

288.name: vigoroth
288.description:
VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated
to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t
tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it
can’t be moving constantly.

289.name: slaking
289.description:
SLAKING spends all day lying down and
lolling about.
It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach,
this POKéMON reluctantly moves to
another spot.

290.name: nincada
290.description:
NINCADA lives underground for many
years in complete darkness.
This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless
as it waits for evolution.

291.name: ninjask
291.description:
NINJASK moves around at such a high
speed that it cannot be seen, even
while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long
believed to be invisible.

292.name: shedinja
292.description:
SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move -
not even a twitch. In fact, its body
appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will
steal the spirit of anyone peering into
its hollow body from its back.

293.name: whismur
293.description:
Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet -
it is barely audible even if one is
paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger,
it starts crying at an earsplitting
volume.

294.name: loudred
294.description:
LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely
decimate a wood-frame house. It uses
its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as
loudspeakers.

295.name: exploud
295.description:
EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the
tremors it creates by bellowing. If this
POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is
preparing to let loose a huge bellow.

296.name: makuhita
296.description:
MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep
getting up and attacking its foe
however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this
POKéMON stores more energy in its body
for evolving.

297.name: hariyama
297.description:
It has the habit of challenging others
without hesitation to tests of strength.
It’s been known to stand on train tracks
and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

298.name: azurill
298.description:
A Pokémon that lives by water.
It moves quickly on land by
bouncing on its big tail.

299.name: nosepass
299.description:
NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always
pointed to the north. If two of these
POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they
are close because their magnetic noses
repel one another.

300.name: skitty
300.description:
SKITTY has the habit of becoming
fascinated by moving objects and
chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after
its own tail and become dizzy.

301.name: delcatty
301.description:
DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered
existence in which it can do as it
pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps
whenever it decides, its daily routines
are completely random.

302.name: sableye
302.description:
SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside
caverns. They are feared, however,
because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their
eyes burn with a sinister glow in the
darkness.

303.name: mawile
303.description:
MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel
horns that have been transformed.
Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard.
When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE
chomps it with its gaping jaws.

304.name: aron
304.description:
This POKéMON has a body of steel.
To make its body, ARON feeds on
iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by
eating bridges and rails.

305.name: lairon
305.description:
LAIRON tempers its steel body by
drinking highly nutritious mineral
springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to
springs of delicious water.

306.name: aggron
306.description:
AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its
own territory. It mercilessly beats up
anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its
territory at all times.

307.name: meditite
307.description:
１にち　１こだけ　きのみを　たべる。
くうふくに　たえることで
こころが　とぎすまされていく。

308.name: medicham
308.description:
It is said that through meditation,
MEDICHAM heightens energy inside
its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by
merging itself with fields and
mountains.

309.name: electrike
309.description:
ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its
long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates
its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs
explosive acceleration performance.

310.name: manectric
310.description:
MANECTRIC is constantly discharging
electricity from its mane. The sparks
sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON
creates thunderclouds.

311.name: plusle
311.description:
PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader
for its partners. Whenever a teammate
puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create
the crackling noises of sparks to show
its joy.

312.name: minun
312.description:
MINUN is more concerned about cheering
on its partners than its own safety.
It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of
sparks to cheer on its teammates.

313.name: volbeat
313.description:
With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits
light from its tail. It communicates with
others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light.
This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet
aroma of ILLUMISE.

314.name: illumise
314.description:
With its sweet aroma, it guides
Volbeat to draw signs with light in
the night sky.

315.name: roselia
315.description:
ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as
projectiles at any opponent that tries
to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings
serenity to living things.

316.name: gulpin
316.description:
Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its
stomach. As a result, it can swallow
something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a
special fluid that digests anything.

317.name: swalot
317.description:
Es verschluckt, was in sein Maul passt, und verdaut es
mit seiner alles zersetzenden Magensäure.

318.name: carvanha
318.description:
CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws
and its sharply pointed fangs pack the
destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and
sunk by this POKéMON.

319.name: sharpedo
319.description:
Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,”
SHARPEDO is widely feared.
Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off.
Just one of these POKéMON can
thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.

320.name: wailmer
320.description:
WAILMER’s nostrils are located above
its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves
to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body
out of its nostrils.

321.name: wailord
321.description:
WAILORD is the largest of all identified
POKéMON up to now.
This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive
amounts of food at once with its
enormous mouth.

322.name: numel
322.description:
NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it
doesn’t notice being hit. However, it
can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething
cauldron of boiling magma.

323.name: camerupt
323.description:
CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body.
Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses
through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this
POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the
superheated magma.

324.name: torkoal
324.description:
You can tell how it’s feeling by the smoke
spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity
is a sign of good health.

325.name: spoink
325.description:
SPOINK bounces around on its tail.
The shock of its bouncing makes its
heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it
stops, its heart will stop.

326.name: grumpig
326.description:
GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its
body to amplify its psychic power waves
for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special
power, its snorting breath grows
labored.

327.name: spinda
327.description:
No two Spinda have the same
pattern of spots. Its tottering
step fouls the aim of foes.

328.name: trapinch
328.description:
TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like
pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently
waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength
to crush even boulders.

329.name: vibrava
329.description:
２片翅膀高速振動
產生的超音波會
引起劇烈的頭痛。

330.name: flygon
330.description:
FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental 
spirit of the desert.” Because its
flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this POKéMON is always enveloped in a
sandstorm while flying.

331.name: cacnea
331.description:
En stockant l’eau dans son corps,
cet habitant du désert peut 
survivre 30 jours sans boire.

332.name: cacturne
332.description:
During the daytime, CACTURNE remains
unmoving so that it does not lose any
moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night
when the temperature drops.

333.name: swablu
333.description:
SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that
are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON
is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and
sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

334.name: altaria
334.description:
Il vole librement en se cachant dans les nuages.
Son chant est digne de celui de la plus douée des
sopranos.

335.name: zangoose
335.description:
Memories of battling its arch-rival
SEVIPER are etched into every cell of
ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks
with incredible agility.

336.name: seviper
336.description:
SEVIPER shares a generations-long
feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its
body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword-
edged tail.

337.name: lunatone
337.description:
LUNATONE was discovered at a location
where a meteorite fell. As a result, some
people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has
been able to prove this theory so far.

338.name: solrock
338.description:
Solar energy is the source of its power,
so it is strong during the daytime.
When it spins, its body shines.

339.name: barboach
339.description:
BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve
as a superb radar system.
This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits
for prey to come along.

340.name: whiscash
340.description:
WHISCASH is extremely territorial.
Just one of these POKéMON will claim a
large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes
about and triggers a massive
earthquake.

341.name: corphish
341.description:
Its hardy vitality enables it to
adapt to any environment. Its
pincers will never release prey.

342.name: crawdaunt
342.description:
CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent
nature that compels it to challenge
other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in
ponds inhabited by this POKéMON,
making them desolate places.

343.name: baltoy
343.description:
BALTOY moves while spinning around on
its one foot. Primitive wall paintings
depicting this POKéMON living among people were discovered in some ancient
ruins.

344.name: claydol
344.description:
CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made
by primitive humans and brought to life
by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while
levitating.

345.name: lileep
345.description:
LILEEP became extinct approximately
a hundred million years ago.
This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches
approaching prey using tentacles 
shaped like flower petals.

346.name: cradily
346.description:
CRADILY roams around the ocean floor
in search of food. This POKéMON freely
extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight
tentacles.

347.name: anorith
347.description:
ANORITH was regenerated from a
prehistoric fossil. This primitive
POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its
two large claws.

348.name: armaldo
348.description:
ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks
bounce off. This POKéMON’s two
enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to
punch right through a steel slab.

349.name: feebas
349.description:
FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and
tattered from the start of its life.
Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored.
It is capable of living in both the sea
and in rivers.

350.name: milotic
350.description:
Ses splendides écailles aux couleurs
de l’arc-en-ciel changent de teinte
selon l’angle de vue.

351.name: castform
351.description:
CASTFORM’s appearance changes with
the weather.
This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect
its tiny body.

352.name: kecleon
352.description:
It changes body color to blend in with
its surroundings. It also changes color if
it is happy or sad.

353.name: shuppet
353.description:
SHUPPET is attracted by feelings
of jealousy and vindictiveness.
If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear
in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves
of that person’s home.

354.name: banette
354.description:
BANETTE generates energy for laying
strong curses by sticking pins into its
own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful
plush doll that was thrown away.

355.name: duskull
355.description:
DUSKULL can pass through any wall no
matter how thick it may be.
Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended
victim until the break of dawn.

356.name: dusclops
356.description:
DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow -
there is nothing at all inside.
It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything
into its body, but nothing will ever come
back out.

357.name: tropius
357.description:
Puede volar al agitar sus grandes hojas. Reparte entre
los niños la codiciada fruta dulce que crece de su
cuello.

358.name: chimecho
358.description:
CHIMECHO makes its cries echo
inside its hollow body. When this
POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have
the power to knock foes flying.

359.name: absol
359.description:
Every time ABSOL appears before people,
it is followed by a disaster such as an
earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the
disaster POKéMON.

360.name: wynaut
360.description:
WYNAUT can always be seen with a big,
happy smile on its face. Look at its tail
to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be
slapping the ground with its tail.

361.name: snorunt
361.description:
SNORUNT live in regions with heavy
snowfall. In seasons without snow, such
as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among
stalactites and stalagmites deep in
caverns.

362.name: glalie
362.description:
GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it
hardens with an armor of ice.
This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any
shape it desires.

363.name: spheal
363.description:
SPHEAL is much faster rolling than 
walking to get around. When groups of
this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this,
their mealtimes are noisy.

364.name: sealeo
364.description:
SEALEO has the habit of always juggling
on the tip of its nose anything it sees
for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains
itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL
on its nose.

365.name: walrein
365.description:
It swims through icy seas while shattering
ice floes with its large tusks. It is
protected by its thick blubber.

366.name: clamperl
366.description:
CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good
for protection - it is also used for
clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be
scored with nicks and scratches all
over.

367.name: huntail
367.description:
HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by
people for a long time because it lives
at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly
even in the murky dark depths of the
ocean.

368.name: gorebyss
368.description:
헤엄치는 모습이 굉장히 우아하다.
가는 입으로 바위 틈새에 나 있는
해초를 먹는다.

369.name: relicanth
369.description:
RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that
existed for a hundred million years
without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on
microscopic organisms with its
toothless mouth.

370.name: luvdisc
370.description:
LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the
tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON
earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the
ocean’s waves.

371.name: bagon
371.description:
Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping
off cliffs every day.

372.name: shelgon
372.description:
Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells
are in the midst of transformation
to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy,
making its movements sluggish.

373.name: salamence
373.description:
SALAMENCE came about as a result of a
strong, long-held dream of growing
wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in
this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to
sprout its magnificent wings.

374.name: beldum
374.description:
Il dégage un champ magnétique opposé à celui
de la terre, ce qui lui permet de léviter.

375.name: metang
375.description:
When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG
is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are
joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically,
this POKéMON generates strong
psychokinetic power.

376.name: metagross
376.description:
METAGROSS has four brains in total.
Combined, the four brains can breeze
through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer.
This POKéMON can float in the air by
tucking in its four legs.

377.name: regirock
377.description:
Its entire body is made of rock.
If any part chips off in battle, it
attaches rocks to repair itself.

378.name: regice
378.description:
REGICE’s body was made during an ice
age. The deep-frozen body can’t be
melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of
minus 328 degrees F.

379.name: registeel
379.description:
REGISTEEL has a body that is harder
than any kind of metal.
Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON
eats.

380.name: latias
380.description:
LATIAS is highly sensitive to the
emotions of people. If it senses any
hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries
shrilly to intimidate the foe.

381.name: latios
381.description:
LATIOS has the ability to make its foe
see an image of what it has seen or
imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and
understands human speech.

382.name: kyogre
382.description:
KYOGRE has the power to create massive
rain clouds that cover the entire sky
and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were
suffering from droughts.

383.name: groudon
383.description:
Dicen que este Pokémon legendario simboliza la tierra.
Tras batirse en duelo con Kyogre se echó a dormir.

384.name: rayquaza
384.description:
RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions
of years in the earth’s ozone layer, 
never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water
and particles in the atmosphere.

385.name: jirachi
385.description:
A legend states that JIRACHI will make
true any wish that is written on notes
attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will
fight without awakening.

386.name: deoxys-normal
386.description:
The DNA of a space virus underwent a
sudden mutation upon exposure to a
laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s
chest appears to be its brain.

387.name: turtwig
387.description:
Made from soil, the shell on its
back hardens when it drinks water.
It lives along lakes.

388.name: grotle
388.description:
It knows where pure water wells
up. It carries fellow Pokémon there
on its back.

389.name: torterra
389.description:
Small Pokémon occasionally gather
on its unmoving back to begin
building their nests.

390.name: chimchar
390.description:
It agilely scales sheer cliffs to
live atop craggy mountains. Its
fire is put out when it sleeps.

391.name: monferno
391.description:
To intimidate attackers, it
stretches the fire on its tail
to make itself appear bigger.

392.name: infernape
392.description:
It uses a special kind of martial
arts involving all its limbs.
Its fire never goes out.

393.name: piplup
393.description:
Because it is very proud, it hates
accepting food from people. Its
thick down guards it from cold.

394.name: prinplup
394.description:
It lives alone, away from others.
Apparently, every one of them
believes it is the most important.

395.name: empoleon
395.description:
The three horns that extend from
its beak attest to its power. The
leader has the biggest horns.

396.name: starly
396.description:
They flock in great numbers.
Though small, they flap their
wings with great power.

397.name: staravia
397.description:
It flies around forests and fields
in search of bug Pokémon.
It stays within a huge flock.

398.name: staraptor
398.description:
It has a savage nature. It will
courageously challenge foes that
are much larger.

399.name: bidoof
399.description:
With nerves of steel, nothing can
perturb it. It is more agile and
active than it appears.

400.name: bibarel
400.description:
It makes its nest by damming
streams with bark and mud. It is
known as an industrious worker.

401.name: kricketot
401.description:
It shakes its head back to front,
causing its antennae to hit each
other and sound like a xylophone.

402.name: kricketune
402.description:
It crosses its knifelike arms in
front of its chest when it cries.
It can compose melodies ad lib.

403.name: shinx
403.description:
All of its fur dazzles if danger is
sensed. It flees while the foe is
momentarily blinded.

404.name: luxio
404.description:
遇到敌人时会从脚
伸出有着百万伏特
威力的爪子来迎战。

405.name: luxray
405.description:
It has eyes that can see through
anything. It spots and captures
prey hiding behind objects.

406.name: budew
406.description:
Over the winter, it closes its bud
and endures the cold. In spring,
the bud opens and releases pollen.

407.name: roserade
407.description:
Con i movimenti di una ballerina, colpisce con le
fruste, piene di spine velenose.

408.name: cranidos
408.description:
It lived in jungles around 100
million years ago. Its skull is as
hard as iron.

409.name: rampardos
409.description:
Its powerful head butt has enough
power to shatter even the most
durable things upon impact.

410.name: shieldon
410.description:
A Pokémon that lived in jungles
around 100 million years ago. Its
facial hide is extremely hard.

411.name: bastiodon
411.description:
Any frontal attack is repulsed.
It is a docile Pokémon that
feeds on grass and berries.

412.name: burmy
412.description:
To shelter itself from cold, wintry
winds, it covers itself with a cloak
made of twigs and leaves.

413.name: wormadam-plant
413.description:
When BURMY evolved, its cloak
became a part of this Pokémon’s
body. The cloak is never shed.

414.name: mothim
414.description:
It loves the honey of flowers
and steals honey collected by
COMBEE.

415.name: combee
415.description:
A Pokémon formed by three others.
It busily carries sweet floral
honey to VESPIQUEN.

416.name: vespiquen
416.description:
Its abdomen is a honeycomb for
grubs. It raises its grubs on
honey collected by COMBEE.

417.name: pachirisu
417.description:
It makes fur balls that crackle
with static electricity. It stores
them with berries in tree holes.

418.name: buizel
418.description:
It has a flotation sac that is
like an inflatable collar. It floats
on water with its head out.

419.name: floatzel
419.description:
It floats using its well-developed
flotation sac. It assists in the
rescues of drowning people.

420.name: cherubi
420.description:
栄養の　詰まった　玉は
鳥ポケモンの　大好物。
ついばまれないよう　逃げまわる。

421.name: cherrim
421.description:
It blooms during times of strong
sunlight. It tries to make up for
everything it endured as a bud.

422.name: shellos
422.description:
Its colors and shapes differ from
region to region. In the Sinnoh
region, two types are confirmed.

423.name: gastrodon
423.description: Attaqué par un prédateur, il fuit en libérant un liquide mauve.

424.name: ambipom
424.description:
To eat, it deftly shucks nuts
with its two tails. It rarely uses
its arms now.

425.name: drifloon
425.description:
A Pokémon formed by the spirits
of people and Pokémon. It loves
damp, humid seasons.

426.name: drifblim
426.description:
At dusk, swarms of them are
carried aloft on winds. When
noticed, they suddenly vanish.

427.name: buneary
427.description:
It slams foes by sharply uncoiling
its rolled ears. It stings enough
to make a grown-up cry in pain.

428.name: lopunny
428.description:
An extremely cautious Pokémon.
It cloaks its body with its fluffy
ear fur when it senses danger.

429.name: mismagius
429.description:
Its cries sound like incantations.
Those hearing it are tormented
by headaches and hallucinations.

430.name: honchkrow
430.description:
Becoming active at night, it is
known to swarm with numerous
MURKROW in tow.

431.name: glameow
431.description:
It claws if displeased and purrs
when affectionate. Its fickleness
is very popular among some.

432.name: purugly
432.description:
It is a brazen brute that barges
its way into another Pokémon’s
nest and claims it as its own.

433.name: chingling
433.description:
It emits cries by agitating an orb
at the back of its throat.
It moves with flouncing hops.

434.name: stunky
434.description:
It protects itself by spraying a
noxious fluid from its rear. The
stench lingers for 24 hours.

435.name: skuntank
435.description:
It sprays a vile-smelling fluid
from the tip of its tail to attack.
Its range is over 160 feet.

436.name: bronzor
436.description:
Se dice que brilla y refleja la verdad al pulirlo,
aunque es algo que detesta.

437.name: bronzong
437.description:
One caused a news sensation when
it was dug up at a construction
site after a 2,000-year sleep.

438.name: bonsly
438.description:
It looks as if it is always crying.
It is actually adjusting its body’s
fluid levels by eliminating excess.

439.name: mime-jr
439.description:
It habitually mimics foes. Once
mimicked, the foe cannot take its
eyes off this Pokémon.

440.name: happiny
440.description:
It loves round white things.
It carries an egg-shaped rock in
imitation of CHANSEY.

441.name: chatot
441.description:
It can learn and speak human
words. If they gather, they all
learn the same saying.

442.name: spiritomb
442.description:
A Pokémon that was formed by 108
spirits. It is bound to a fissure
in an odd keystone.

443.name: gible
443.description:
It nests in small, horizontal holes
in cave walls. It pounces to catch
prey that stray too close.

444.name: gabite
444.description:
There is a long-held belief that
medicine made from its scales will
heal even incurable illnesses.

445.name: garchomp
445.description:
When it folds up its body and
extends its wings, it looks like a
jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

446.name: munchlax
446.description:
It wolfs down its weight in food
once a day, swallowing food whole
with almost no chewing.

447.name: riolu
447.description:
The aura that emanates from its
body intensifies to alert others
if it is afraid or sad.

448.name: lucario
448.description:
It has the ability to sense the
auras of all things.
It understands human speech.

449.name: hippopotas
449.description:
It lives in arid places. Instead
of perspiration, it expels grainy
sand from its body.

450.name: hippowdon
450.description:
It blasts internally stored sand
from ports on its body to create
a towering twister for attack.

451.name: skorupi
451.description:
It grips prey with its tail claws
and injects poison. It tenaciously
hangs on until the poison takes.

452.name: drapion
452.description:
It has the power in its clawed
arms to make scrap of a car. The
tips of its claws release poison.

453.name: croagunk
453.description:
Its cheeks hold poison sacs.
It tries to catch foes off guard
to jab them with toxic fingers.

454.name: toxicroak
454.description:
Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin
so vile that even a scratch could
prove fatal.

455.name: carnivine
455.description:
It attracts prey with its sweet-
smelling saliva, then chomps down.
It takes a whole day to eat prey.

456.name: finneon
456.description:
Die Linie an seiner Seite kann Sonnenlicht
speichern. Nachts leuchtet es sehr intensiv.

457.name: lumineon
457.description:
Il vit au plus profond de l’océan. Il attire sa proie en illuminant
les motifs de ses quatre nageoires.

458.name: mantyke
458.description:
A friendly Pokémon that captures
the subtle flows of seawater using
its two antennae.

459.name: snover
459.description:
It lives on snowy mountains.
Having had little contact with
humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

460.name: abomasnow
460.description:
It whips up blizzards in mountains
that are always buried in snow.
It is the abominable snowman.

461.name: weavile
461.description:
They live in cold regions, forming
groups of four or five that hunt
prey with impressive coordination.

462.name: magnezone
462.description:
It evolved from exposure to a
special magnetic field.
Three units generate magnetism.

463.name: lickilicky
463.description:
타액에는 어떤 것도 녹이는
성분이 충분히 포함되어 있어
핥으면 언제까지나 마비된다.

464.name: rhyperior
464.description:
It puts rocks in holes in its palms
and uses its muscles to shoot them.
GEODUDE are shot at rare times.

465.name: tangrowth
465.description:
It ensnares prey by extending
arms made of vines. Losing arms to
predators does not trouble it.

466.name: electivire
466.description:
As its electric charge amplifies,
blue sparks begin to crackle between
its horns.

467.name: magmortar
467.description:
It blasts fireballs of over 3,600
degrees F from the ends of its
arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

468.name: togekiss
468.description:
Es zeigt sich nie an Orten, wo Streit und
Zwietracht herrschen. In letzter Zeit wird es
kaum noch gesehen.

469.name: yanmega
469.description:
By churning its wings, it creates
shock waves that inflict critical
internal injuries to foes.

470.name: leafeon
470.description:
Just like a plant, it uses
photosynthesis. As a result, it is
always enveloped in clear air.

471.name: glaceon
471.description:
As a protective technique, it can
completely freeze its fur to make
its hairs stand like needles.

472.name: gliscor
472.description:
It observes prey while hanging
inverted from branches. When the
chance presents itself, it swoops!

473.name: mamoswine
473.description:
Its impressive tusks are made of
ice. The population thinned when it
turned warm after the ice age.

474.name: porygon-z
474.description:
Additional software was installed
to make it a better Pokémon.
It began acting oddly, however.

475.name: gallade
475.description:
Comme il peut lire les pensées de ses adversaires,
il frappe toujours en premier.

476.name: probopass
476.description:
It freely controls three small
units called Mini-Noses using
magnetic force.

477.name: dusknoir
477.description:
Die Antenne auf seinem Kopf empfängt Radiowellen
aus einer anderen Dimension.

478.name: froslass
478.description:
It freezes foes with an icy breath
nearly -60 degrees F. What seems
to be its body is actually hollow.

479.name: rotom
479.description:
某位少年的发明
促使人们开始制造
各种活用洛托姆的机器 。

480.name: uxie
480.description:
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.”
It is said that it can wipe out the
memory of those who see its eyes.

481.name: mesprit
481.description:
Known as “The Being of Emotion.”
It taught humans the nobility of
sorrow, pain, and joy.

482.name: azelf
482.description:
Known as “The Being of Willpower.”
It sleeps at the bottom of a lake
to keep the world in balance.

483.name: dialga
483.description:
It has the power to control time.
It appears in Sinnoh-region myths
as an ancient deity.

484.name: palkia
484.description:
It has the ability to distort
space. It is described as a deity
in Sinnoh-region mythology.

485.name: heatran
485.description:
It dwells in volcanic caves. It
digs in with its cross-shaped feet
to crawl on ceilings and walls.

486.name: regigigas
486.description:
There is an enduring legend that
states this Pokémon towed
continents with ropes.

487.name: giratina-altered
487.description:
A Pokémon that is said to live in a
world on the reverse side of ours.
It appears in an ancient cemetery.

488.name: cresselia
488.description:
Shiny particles are released from
its wings like a veil. It is said
to represent the crescent moon.

489.name: phione
489.description:
Si sposta nei mari caldi. Torna sempre dove è nato, anche se
si trova molto lontano.

490.name: manaphy
490.description:
Born on a cold seafloor, it
will swim great distances to
return to its birthplace.

491.name: darkrai
491.description:
It can lull people to sleep and
make them dream. It is active
during nights of the new moon.

492.name: shaymin-land
492.description:
Puede disolver las toxinas del aire para transformar
tierra yerma en campos de flores.

493.name: arceus
493.description:
It is described in mythology as
the Pokémon that shaped the
universe with its 1,000 arms.

494.name: victini
494.description:
Un Pokémon qui amène la victoire. On dit
que les Dresseurs qui le possèdent
peuvent gagner n’importe quel combat.

495.name: snivy
495.description:
Un Pokémon intelligent et très calme.
Lorsqu’il a reçu suffisamment de
lumière du soleil, il devient plus agile.

496.name: servine
496.description:
Il court comme s’il glissait sur le sol.
Il déroute l’ennemi par ses mouvements
et l’assomme d’un coup de liane.

497.name: serperior
497.description:
Il peut paralyser l’ennemi d’un regard.
Il amplifie l’énergie du soleil dans
son corps.

498.name: tepig
498.description:
Il évite agilement les attaques ennemies
et crache des boules de feu par le groin.
Il aime griller des Baies pour les manger.

499.name: pignite
499.description:
Quand le feu dans son corps s’embrase,
sa vitesse et son agilité augmentent.
En cas d’urgence, il crache de la fumée.

500.name: emboar
500.description:
Il embrase ses poings avec les flammes
sur son menton et cogne l’ennemi avec.
C’est un Pokémon très solidaire.

501.name: oshawott
501.description:
Il combat avec le coupillage de son
ventre. Il peut parer un assaut et
immédiatement contre-attaquer.

502.name: dewott
502.description:
L’apprentissage de sa technique de
combat, qui utilise élégamment ses deux
coupillages, est extrêmement rigoureux.

503.name: samurott
503.description:
Il peut terrasser ses ennemis d’un coup
de la lame enchâssée dans son armure,
et les faire taire d’un seul regard.

504.name: patrat
504.description:
Ils stockent à manger dans leurs
bajoues et font le guet indéfiniment. Ils
se font des signes en remuant la queue.

505.name: watchog
505.description:
Il attaque en crachant les graines des
Baies qu’il accumule dans ses bajoues.
S’il voit un ennemi, il dresse la queue.

506.name: lillipup
506.description:
Il fait vaillamment face à des ennemis
très puissants, mais il est intelligent
et évite les combats trop inégaux.

507.name: herdier
507.description:
Les poils qui entourent son corps
comme un manteau sont extrêmement
durs et amortissent les coups.

508.name: stoutland
508.description:
Il sauve les gens bloqués dans les
montagnes par des tempêtes de neige.
Ses longs poils le protègent du froid.

509.name: purrloin
509.description:
Il vole les gens pour le plaisir, mais il
est tellement mignon que ses victimes
finissent toujours par lui pardonner.

510.name: liepard
510.description:
Un Pokémon insaisissable. Son style
et son pelage magnifique attirent de
nombreux Dresseurs.

511.name: pansage
511.description:
Il vit dans les forêts profondes.
Manger la feuille qui pousse sur
sa tête fait disparaître la fatigue.

512.name: simisage
512.description:
Il a un tempérament violent et se
bat avec sa queue pleine d’épines.
La feuille sur sa tête est très amère.

513.name: pansear
513.description:
Quand il s’énerve, la mèche sur sa
tête chauffe à 300 °C. Il s’en sert
pour griller des Baies et les manger.

514.name: simisear
514.description:
Il adore les aliments sucrés. Ils lui
servent d’énergie pour alimenter le
feu à l’intérieur de son corps.

515.name: panpour
515.description:
L’eau contenue dans la mèche sur sa
tête est pleine de nutriments. Elle fait
pousser les plantes avec vigueur.

516.name: simipour
516.description:
Il stocke de l’eau dans les mèches de sa
tête. Quand il est à sec, il se ravitaille
en aspirant de l’eau par la queue.

517.name: munna
517.description:
Quand Munna mange un rêve, celui-ci
est aussitôt oublié par le rêveur.
Il lévite en permanence.

518.name: musharna
518.description:
La fumée qui sort de son front contient
les rêves de nombreuses personnes et
ceux de nombreux Pokémon.

519.name: pidove
519.description:
Il suit scrupuleusement les consignes
de son Dresseur, mais il a du mal à
comprendre les ordres trop compliqués.

520.name: tranquill
520.description:
Aussi éloigné qu’il puisse se trouver,
il parvient toujours à retourner
auprès de son Dresseur.

521.name: unfezant
521.description:
Le mâle intimide ses ennemis
avec ses caroncules.
La femelle vole mieux que le mâle.

522.name: blitzle
522.description:
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear.
It can catch lightning with its mane and store
the electricity.

523.name: zebstrika
523.description:
Il réagit à la vitesse de l’éclair.
Lorsqu’il est en plein galop, on peut
entendre le grondement du tonnerre.

524.name: roggenrola
524.description:
Il a une oreille hexagonale. Son
corps, compressé dans des strates
profondes, est dur comme de l’acier.

525.name: boldore
525.description:
Quand il est gonflé à bloc, ses cristaux
orangés scintillent. Il cherche de l’eau
souterraine dans les grottes.

526.name: gigalith
526.description:
Il comprime de l’énergie dans son corps,
et ses attaques sont assez puissantes
pour renverser des montagnes.

527.name: woobat
527.description:
Il vit dans les forêts sombres et les
grottes. Il émet des ultrasons par
le nez pour se diriger.

528.name: swoobat
528.description:
コンクリートも　こわせるほどの
つよい　ちょうおんぱを　だすとき
しっぽが　はげしく　ふるえる。

529.name: drilbur
529.description:
Il peut creuser à plus de 50 km/h et
faire la course avec une voiture roulant
sur le terrain qu’il creuse.

530.name: excadrill
530.description:
Ses vrilles en acier peuvent transpercer
des poutres en fer. Il est très employé
dans la construction de tunnels.

531.name: audino
531.description:
Il ausculte les gens avec ses antennes
auriculaires pour juger de leurs
émotions ou de leur santé.

532.name: timburr
532.description:
Il combat avec une poutre. Quand il en
arrive à transporter de lourds madriers
sans problème, l’évolution est proche.

533.name: gurdurr
533.description:
Même une armée de catcheurs se
jetant sur son corps hyper musclé
ne le ferait pas ciller.

534.name: conkeldurr
534.description:
On pense que la recette du ciment
a été enseignée aux humains par
un Bétochef il y a 2 000 ans.

535.name: tympole
535.description:
Il prévient ses camarades du danger en
faisant vibrer ses joues pour générer
un signal d’alarme très aigu.

536.name: palpitoad
536.description:
Quand il fait vibrer la bosse sur sa tête,
il provoque des ondulations dans l’eau,
mais aussi des tremblements de terre.

537.name: seismitoad
537.description:
Il fait gicler un liquide paralysant des
pustules sur sa tête, et attaque
ses ennemis à coups de vibrations.

538.name: throh
538.description:
Quand il noue sa ceinture, il devient
plus puissant. Les Judokrak sauvages
tressent leur ceinture avec des lianes.

539.name: sawk
539.description:
Es lebt zurückgezogen in den Bergen und trainiert Tag
und Nacht, um seinen Karateschlag zu perfektionieren.

540.name: sewaddle
540.description:
Quand il éclot, Manternel lui coud son
vêtement. Il dort en cachant son
visage sous sa capuche.

541.name: swadloon
541.description:
Dans les forêts où il vit, la végétation
pousse bien car il transforme les
feuilles mortes en engrais.

542.name: leavanny
542.description:
Quand il trouve de petits Pokémon, il
leur coud des vêtements de feuilles en
utilisant ses coupoirs et son fil adhésif.

543.name: venipede
543.description:
Sa morsure est très venimeuse.
Elle paralyse même les grands
Pokémon Oiseaux, ses prédateurs.

544.name: whirlipede
544.description:
Protégé par sa solide carapace,
il fonce sur ses ennemis en
roulant comme un pneu.

545.name: scolipede
545.description:
Il accule l’ennemi par ses mouvements
rapides et l’attaque avec ses cornes.
Il ne s’arrête qu’au coup de grâce.

546.name: cottonee
546.description:
Si on l’attaque, il projette un nuage de
coton. L’ennemi le confond avec lui, ce
qui permet à Doudouvet de s’enfuir.

547.name: whimsicott
547.description:
沒有特定的棲息地。
會乘著旋風移動，
到處現身去惡作劇。

548.name: petilil
548.description:
Les feuilles sur sa tête sont très
amères, mais elles remettent d’aplomb
